blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The state weather bureau declared the start of the “amihan” or northeast monsoon season on Tuesday, anticipating cooler weather, cold surges, and rough sea conditions. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the “amihan” is set to become the primary weather system influencing the majority of the country. Pagasa earlier reported that the amihan season may begin between Oct. 22 and 30.
